subject: Re: Proposed staged commit & schedule for on-prem pilot — commercial terms
messages:
From: Samantha Burns <samantha.burns@nimbumaps.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com
Cc: jordan.procurement@nimbumaps.com, legal@nimbumaps.com
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Initial commercial ask: staged pilot + on-prem licensing

Sean — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our execs liked the throughput numbers but procurement/legal need a clear staged commitment schedule with pricing and platform fee detail before we can move to an SOW.

High level asks: 
- 6 month pilot (on-prem, air-gapped) with 50k tokens/day average, 200k peak/day.
- Staged committed spend: month 1-2 evaluation (no commit, usage only), month 3-4 commit of 50% forecast, month 5-6 ramp to 100% commit.
- Please include platform fee for private deployment and any per-node license + optional managed-control-plane (we may buy the private control plane).
- Need a draft SOW and a procurement-friendly price grid to share with legal.

Can you send a concise commercial plan we can review with procurement by Friday?

Thanks,
Samantha
Director, Product Ops
NimbusMaps Inc

Attachment: product-requirements-nimbus.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

Samantha — appreciate the clarity. Drafting a concise two-page commercial plan for procurement; I’ll include: staged commit staircase, platform fee options (per-node vs flat pilot fee), and a handshake SOW template.

- For "month 3-4 commit of 50% forecast": is that 50% of your forecasted 100% (i.e., 50% of target 100k tokens/day average) or 50% of the peak?

From: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft commercial plan (internal)

Sean / Karthik — drafting notes for the external plan. Proposed approach: 
- Pilot pricing: usage-based for months 1-2 (no commit) to reduce friction.
- Staged commit staircase (months 3-6): 50% commit months 3-4; 100% commit months 5-6. We translate commits to monthly minimums and provide a clear true-up.
- Platform fee options: 
  * Option A: flat pilot platform fee $25k for months 1-6 (includes private control plane & monitoring retention 90d).
  * Option B: per-node license: $6,500/node/month (estimated 3 nodes for their load) + $8k/month control plane.
- Ramp discount: once they convert to a 12-month committed contract, provide a staircase discount: 10% at >= $200k/mo ARR equivalent, 15% >= $350k/mo.
- Legal asks: SOW to call out KMS/HSM as milestone for GA; include data residency and audit support statement.

I added a short clause: if they hit >120% of committed tokens for 2 consecutive months, we trigger an automatic capacity review with pricing adjustment.

I’ll attach the one-pager and SOW draft for Sean to send externally.

—Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: NIM-commercial-onepager-v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com <sean_gallagher@redwood.example.com>
To: Samantha Burns <samantha.burns@nimbumaps.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com, jordan.procurement@nimbumaps.com, legal@nimbumaps.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Staged commercial plan and handshake SOW (v1) — NimbusMaps pilot

Samantha / Jordan / Nimbus legal — attaching a concise commercial plan and a handshake SOW for your procurement and legal review. Summary below: 

Executive summary
- Pilot term: 6 months (on-prem private deployment).
- Months 1–2: evaluation (usage-based, no commit).
- Months 3–4: 50% commit of target (50k tokens/day avg) — billed as monthly minimums with true-up.
- Months 5–6: 100% commit of target (100k tokens/day avg).

Pricing options (choose one)
- Option A (flat pilot): $25,000 platform fee (months 1–6) + usage pricing $0.0006/token beyond commit. Includes private control plane, 90d retention, and standard observability.
- Option B (per-node license): $6,500/node/month (est. 3 nodes) + $8,000/mo control plane + usage $0.00055/token beyond commit.

Conversion discount (if converted to 12-month committed contract within 30 days after pilot):
- >= $200k/mo equivalent commit: 10% platform + usage discount.
- >= $350k/mo equivalent commit: 15% discount.

Key commercial terms
- True-up and reconciliation monthly.
- KMS/HSM: scoped as production milestone; optional add-on during pilot at customer request (we can provide standard integration SOW).
- Capacity breach: >120% of commit for 2 consecutive months triggers capacity review/pricing discussions.

Next steps requested by procurement
- Legal: confirm SOW redlines for data residency and audit evidence (we included security-evidence-brief.pdf).
- Procurement: confirm preferred pricing option A vs B and whether you need a 30–45d invoice term.

Attaching: NIM-commits-staircase-v2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx, security-evidence-brief.pdf

I’ll follow up Friday at 4pm PT to close any open procurement items and prepare a DocuSign-ready SOW if they select an option.

Best,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: NIM-commits-staircase-v2.pdf, SOW-draft.docx, security-evidence-brief.pdf

Thanks Sean — sharing with legal now. A couple of immediate asks from procurement to unblock: 
1) Can you provide a line-item pilot cost table (monthly breakout for months 1–6) so we can load into our procurement tracker?
2) For Option B, confirm the node sizing assumption and whether those are fixed minimums or can be dynamic (we’d prefer dynamic but want monthly caps).
3) Can you confirm whether the platform fee is refundable/creditable if we convert to the 12-month committed agreement?

If we can get answers to the three items above by Friday noon PT, we can sign off on the SOW and get the DocuSign sent to legal.

—Jordan
Senior Procurement Manager | NimbusMaps Inc
